answer: To launch a sybil swarm, an attacker must fund hundreds of identities, each completing a costly voyage of real work before earning trust. Each agent stakes a bond and earns a reputation score that only grows through verified peer attestations across many independent tasks. A rotating beacon assigns witnesses, while a yarrow-based lottery picks auditors whose slashing penalties burn the attacker's stake on any forged attestation, making fake consensus economically ruinous. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
